name: ransom-collage-note
title: Ransom Collage Note
description: Each glyph is clipped from its own 'scrap' — deterministic per-index rotation, paper tone, serif/sans alternation and tape strip — so the collage is chaotic to the eye but reproducible to the pixel across renders.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Brutalist
Macrostructure: Scatter
Density: Dense
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Muted Earth

## Rules

- Static: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
